name: relay-admission-frame-1
description: ADR-038 §6.2 frame vector: byte-pinned protobuf frames of the /msp/relay-ticket/1 pre-flight protocol (§3.2). A second implementation (TS or Rust) must reproduce identical bytes and identical verdicts. Encodings are proto2 wire format: field 1 varint (type), field 2 length-delimited bytes (ticket), field 3 varint (code), uvarint length prefixes as noted.
present_frame_notes: 0800 = field1 varint PRESENT(0); 12 <uvarint> = field2 length-delimited, uvarint length 425; then the relay-ticket-1 token bytes (UTF-8). Regenerated 2026-10-15 with the real derived identity pair (drift ruling (b) closure) — the frame embeds the token, so it moves with the ticket vectors.
status_frame_notes: 0801 = field1 varint STATUS(1); 18 <uvarint> = field3 varint code (100=0x64, 201=0xc9 01, 202=0xca 01, 400=0x90 03)
length_prefix_rule: each frame body is uvarint-length-prefixed on the wire AFTER protocol negotiation; the 4096-byte cap is validated before allocation

malformed_corpus.why: tag byte 0x00 is field 0 — invalid in protobuf
field2 announces 2047 bytes but only 2 follow (uvarint ff 0f = 2047)
field1 varint value 5 is neither PRESENT(0) nor STATUS(1)
field2 tag with no length byte — truncation
field2 varint (wire type 0) where bytes (wire type 2) is required
